blocks.text:
Anthony Russell attacked Huntley with a metal bar while they were in a recycling workshop at HMP Frankland

A whole-life prisoner has admitted murdering the Soham killer Ian Huntley at a high-security jail.

Anthony Russell went on trial at Newcastle crown court on Monday, accused of killing the 52-year-old by swinging a 4kg metal bar at least six times at his head, in what the prosecution said was a “cold-blooded murder” that he planned for weeks.
